## Approach

For this assignment I will use the New York Times Books API to explore whether books that have spent more weeks on the bestseller list tend to have higher rankings. I will focus on the current Hardcover Fiction Best Sellers list and use R to retrieve data from the API, parse the JSON response, and organize the results into a tidy data frame.

## API Description

The New York Times Books API provides information about bestseller lists, including book titles, authors, rankings, and the number of weeks each book has appeared on a list.

I will use the following endpoint:

`https://api.nytimes.com/svc/books/v3/lists/current/hardcover-fiction.json`

The request uses `current` to retrieve the latest available list and `hardcover-fiction` to specify the book category. Authentication requires an API key.

Source: <https://developer.nytimes.com/docs/books-product/1/overview>
